name: mash-workbench-marketplace
description: MASH (Memories, Agents, Skills, Hooks): plugins that turn repeated work into tooling and review changes against project standards

plugins.name: mash-workbench

plugins.description: Review changes against your project's review standards (skills), record the bugs a review passed, and turn them into new standards. Instructions only: no Python, no hooks, no scripts. Say "mash review" to pick it.
